note: Rows sourced verbatim from the official SCORES jurisdiction-exclusion table at https://scores.sebi.gov.in/faqs (FAQ #4), crawled 2026-08-25 — see data/json/sebi/scores/9af174a92a299ccd.json and data/clean/sebi/scores/9af174a92a299ccd.md for the raw extraction. This is the first primary-source confirmation of the jurisdiction boundaries drafted from general knowledge in 05_JURISDICTION_MATRIX.md.

authorities.jurisdiction_scope: Securities market: SEBI Act 1992, SCRA 1956, Depositories Act 1996, relevant Companies Act 2013 provisions administered by SEBI
authorities.phone_notes: Toll-free, 8 languages (English, Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Tamil, Bengali, Telugu, Kannada), 9am-6pm all days excluding declared holidays
authorities.outside_scope_description: Bank deposits/NBFC matters, unlisted companies, insurance, pension funds, competition matters, housing finance, insolvency proceedings, suspended-company trading disputes, IEPF-eligible unclaimed dividends/shares, matters sub judice or pending/concluded in ODR

authorities.jurisdiction_scope: Securities-market disputes escalated from SCORES or approached directly; conciliation then arbitration

authorities.authority_name: Reserve Bank of India / Banking Ombudsman
authorities.jurisdiction_scope: Bank deposits; Fixed Deposits with NBFCs; other NBFC/Primary Dealer matters

Deposits under Companies Act ss.73-74; unlisted companies; company mismanagement/AGM disputes; Nidhi companies; struck-off/vanishing companies; matters under Companies Act overriding powers; sick companies/moratorium; companies under liquidation
Unclaimed dividends, shares, matured debentures, fractional-share sale proceeds, unclaimed preference-share redemption amounts transferred to IEPF after 7+ years unclaimed (Companies Act 2013 s.125)
authorities.outside_scope_description: Explicitly outside SEBI/SCORES purview per SCORES FAQ #4 — claim directly from IEPF Authority via Form IEPF-5

authorities.authority_name: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India
authorities.jurisdiction_scope: Companies where insolvency proceedings have started
